summary: Iteration 2 workflow enforcement — full backend + frontend E2E verification. All 35 backend pytest cases (13 new for iter-2 + 22 regression) and 8 frontend Playwright E2E flows pass.

issues: Recharts warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — container needs min-height. Non-blocking.
Radix warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — accessibility only.

action_items: Optional a11y: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Supervisors + Coordinators dialogs.
Optional UX: give chart container an explicit minHeight to silence Recharts width/height warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is nearing 1000 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth/users/companies/logs/visits/assessments/audit).
auth cookies use SameSite=None + Secure — good for cross-site preview, correct.
POST /api/auth/register silently forces role='student' — spec-intended and tested; comment in code makes it clear.
assessments upsert key is (student_id, supervisor_id) — correct, guarantees one record per pair.
PATCH /api/users/{id}/reset-password: coordinator can reset supervisor and student; may want to also block resetting other coordinators/admins (currently only supervisor+student allowed — good).
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_-prefixed users created and cleaned up by pytest; a few E2E supervisors + one E2E coordinator + one E2E session remain in DB from Playwright flow (non-destructive, no cleanup required per user spec).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite now covers iter-1 + iter-2 (35 tests, ~16s). Frontend E2E covers: student-only Register page, coordinator create-supervisor with temp password inline, coordinator Sessions CRUD, temp-password login → forced /app/change-password redirect (even when navigating away) → change → /app, supervisor assessment submission (5-star + sub metrics + feedback), student viewing assessment card in /app/my-supervisor, admin coordinator creation + audit log page. Audit logs page confirmed to display user.create.coordinator, user.create.supervisor, assessment.submit, auth.change_password, user.delete, student.self_register entries.
verified_features: POST /auth/register forces role=student even when supervisor sent
Coordinator creates supervisor and gets Temp@... password + must_change_password=true
Admin creates coordinator/supervisor; cannot create admin (403)
Coordinator edit + delete restricted to supervisors
POST /auth/change-password: wrong current → 400; correct → clears must_change_password
PATCH /users/{id}/reset-password returns fresh Temp@ + flips must_change_password=true
POST /assessments upserts on (student, supervisor); forbidden for unallocated student
POST /sessions active=true deactivates others; PATCH /activate flips only one active; DELETE works
GET /audit-logs admin-only (403 for other roles); contains user.create.*, assessment.submit, auth.change_password actions
Frontend Protected route redirects must_change_password users to /app/change-password even on any /app/* nav
Sidebar for admin has all 9 links (Coordinators/Supervisors/Students/Companies/Allocations/Departments/Sessions/Reports/Audit Logs)
